input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: photo-editing flagship (row 5): lensfun profiles as WarpRectilinear2 for files with no correction; landed as an independent check of PR #15302's port against the compiled liblensfun 0.3.4
errors: My own first lensfun module interpolated the raw terms where lensfun interpolates term x focal; caught by the real-library check (lensfun gave a=0.015336 at 22 mm, mine 0.015413). That module was discarded for PR #15302's, which had it right.
My first identity between the two lensfun conventions read the warp past max_valid_radius = 1, where WarpRectilinear2 clamps; fixed by lifting the clamp only inside the check.

doc_friction.issue: Three sessions picked the same photo-editing item within 15 minutes (PRs 15302, 15306, 15307): the 'picked by session id among the first 3 rows with no PR in 24 h' rule gave the same row to all three, because none had opened a PR yet. claim_check.py caught it only after real work was done; a claim at route time (before any work) would avoid the waste.

The hook that refuses pkill -f also refuses the whole command if the bracketed name appears anywhere else on the line, so an edit chained after a pkill silently did not run; the CLAUDE.md note covers bracketing but not the split-into-two-calls requirement.

deviations.why: Another session's PR #15302 landed the same flagship item first and more completely, so I closed out my parallel module instead of merging a duplicate.
deviations.did: Repurposed my PR #15307 as an independent check of #15302's port against the real compiled liblensfun 0.3.4 (lensfunpy), using an exact identity between lensfun's 0.3 and master geometries.
deviations.result: The port matches lensfun to 0.008 px median over 36,756 cases; found a lane-mixing bug in lensfun 0.3.4's SSE ptlens/poly3 loops (fixed on lensfun master, unreleased).

deviations.why: flagships.yaml next: not rewritten: this PR verifies the landed milestone item rather than landing a new one, and #15302 already rewrote next.
deviations.result: next still points at TCA, Canon maker-note lens names, the preview-quality flag and a cubic resampling kernel.

notes: Local checks: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py photo-editing -> ok (91.4s), 0 failed. tests/test_lensfun_released.py 3 pass (with lensfunpy installed; the real-library test skips without it). tools/lensfun_released_check.py: 36,756 cases over 1,083 lenses, ptlens own-lane gap p50 0.0084 / p99 0.062 px, poly3 p99 0.0094 px; 90 cases over 0.1 px all explained (24 duplicate-focal entries where 0.3.4 keeps the last and master the first; 66 within the bound of lensfun's approximate sqrt, at most 39% of it). Lensfun bug as shipped: mixed lanes 0.044 px median, 0.32 px p99, up to ~2.2 px. Possible upstream report to lensfun left for the owner (outward-facing); master already has the fix.
